name: canals-dev
description: Dev-only tooling and quality gate for the Canals Civ VII mod. Not shipped.

scripts.check: for f in ui/canals*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run pedia && npm run i18n && npm run rules && npm run modinfo && npm run sequences
scripts.test: node --test tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/canal-rules.test.mjs tests/canal-placement.test.mjs tests/canal-look.test.mjs tests/canals-modinfo.test.mjs tests/canal-sequences.test.mjs && npm run pedia
